notes.title: 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, wrestling folks!

We have some cool new QOL additions and fixes coming your way with this update! We heard you, and we got you. Here’s the list of slams this update has to offer:
[olist]
[*][b]New languages have been added -[/b] we’re now ready to slam in Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/36ee9fec85dbef8d468ce24040d34a4d0830f7c0.gif[/img]

[*][b]Equipment Management -[/b] need to get out of your wrestling gear quickly? No problem! Now, we have an Unequip All function! Perfect for that costume change before your next match. Additionally, we’ve added a quick way to sort your inventory and equipment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/1caad6069d50736bc1afea922fcb1c1f4091ab7e.gif[/img]

[*][b]Dungeon Skip -[/b] now you can quickly go to the other side of a dungeon on the World Map without going inside. This applies only to dungeons that you have already completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/1dba34c5723db0751c32eb5479e2d36c5776bbb6.gif[/img]

[*][b]Better Numbers! -[/b] stat boosting items now show adjusted character stats instead of the character’s HP and AP only.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/776bb807bdcec703c8238af10fa4fa2391aa3427.gif[/img]
[/olist]
Aside from the main things above, here’s a list of the [b]miscellaneous QOL adjustments and bugfixes[/b] that are slamming their way with the 1.2 update!
[list]
[*] Treasure Chest Progress location names updated
[*] Now able to load another save file without going to the main menu 
[*] UI adjustments - overall text enlargement, new combat HP heal bar display, new game icons, name adjustments, and more!
[*] Achievements that were not being tracked properly now all work 
[*] The game no longer crashes when closing either by force or normally
[*] Softlocks with areas in dungeons and fleeing combat 
[*] Combat freezes after QTE during the pin tutorial
[*] Resolution resizing now functions properly
[*] Collision sweep to remove pesky edge cases
[*] Map loading time optimized and reduced!
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Can’t get enough wrestling RPG action? Don’t worry, as we’re keeping the slams coming with balancing updates, bug fixes, and more, so let’s take [i]WrestleQuest[/i] to the next level together! We’ll be posting like this in the future before updates, so expect to see all the slamtastic features here first!

We thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for taking this journey with us to wrestling stardom. If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url] and let us know. We’d be more than happy to see you there!

Happy powerbombs, everyone!

notes.title: WrestleQuest Mega Update Extravaganza!
notes.notes:
Hello, wrestling folks!

We’re overjoyed and excited to announce that our 1.1 is up and ready for all the wrestlers to slam! Here’s a summarization of the new features that we’ve announced over the past few weeks:

[olist][*][b]Flee [/b] - need to make a strategic exit? Worry no more! The new Flee mechanic will allow players to escape harm whenever they need to! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/4a5cb4a47973c5d1bef78c6f32c086df2ed8a8ea.gif[/img]

[*][b]Gimmicks Menu Adjustment [/b] - We heard your comments about the UI being difficult to navigate. We’ve implemented better scrolling so you get to wherever you need easier and faster!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/0f2d32c1ba0a0ccf3497a757c58bfde74bf45efe.gif[/img]

[*][b]Improved Bosses [/b] - No more waiting on rounds for your HP to drop during those cinematic battles! The bosses in unwinnable fights now deal enough damage to make you lose so you can stick to the script better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/2d58ffc655b79fc10a8bf0ac279449a8f765cf16.gif[/img]

[*][b]Combat Fast Forward [/b] - In a rush to be somewhere? Use the Fast Forward button to speed up the combat! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/14bdb65c95f67a1045e8efbd749512d791288f5c.gif[/img]

[*][b]Crafting Recipes [/b] - Time to be a master crafter! The crafting recipes now tell you what category the craftables belong to as you purchase them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/920b4d01f24eb4720de605149ac95b400d9bf4d0.gif[/img]

[*][b]Surge Dome Arena UI [/b] - The gladiatorial combat center receives an upgrade! Now, you can see the challengers before the fight as well as the reward that you can win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/1da0b981185400df73a118fbbeed5b5bc6178262.gif[/img]

[*][b]Enemy Awareness Radius Reduction [/b] - Be sneaky! It’s now easier to sneak around enemies and escape danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/096fd40ecd652443ecf7ace73ed2ba82a1d55cea.gif[/img]

[*][b]Heal Outside of Combat[/b] - You can now use your healing gimmicks to heal outside of combat! Win your next fight by making sure your party members are all ready to rock and slam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/bcbf70c63682e26db0ad5ea7d42b69d1c1f267f5.gif[/img]

[*][b]Detective Pad[/b] - It’s time to be a better detective! You can now back out and see if you are prepared to present your findings and solve the mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/b47d373a1c5d946fd16749de3be3714bdc2b6f95.gif[/img]

[*][b]Minigame Skip[/b] - All minigames can now be skipped! Previously, only some of them were skippable, but we found that some players wanted to skip through any of them, so we added that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/72091bb9d022c597200ff9af29d12592579a375b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/b67b889123bad86ccc7f119ed910f818384b2404.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/174fcce0127bf2fab2b809e14bb83688237858eb.gif[/img]

[*][b]Healing Items buff[/b] - We heard the concern that some healing items become useless in the later parts of the game. They now heal through a percentage instead of a flat value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/e77967ff5be3f45400b15257f629ba28563ad6d0.gif[/img]

[*][b]AP Regeneration[/b] - You’ll be able to replenish your sweatiness whenever QTEs or timed events are pressed successfully (Yes, it includes when auto-win QTE is turned on)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/b11c8dfdda44fa69a01ad31d43736448529ff53f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/5e67ed453878a350accc00eab30b4ffccb3ebc60.gif[/img]

[*][b]Run Toggle[/b] - We heard you guys, and we adjusted the run to be a toggle instead of needing to hold it the entire time when running!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120541/626f867148d2e0804b0b932e65459db56ec6a892.gif[/img][/olist]

On top of these new features, here is a quick rundown of some issues that we’ve squashed! The list includes but is not limited to the following: 

[list][*] A random block during the Boss Rush
[*] Unable to get out of the dungeon during post-credit gameplay
[*] Characters respawning in colliders after the combat
[*] Getting stuck within colliders
[*] Accessing combat tutorials causes a block
[*] Game gets stuck in a black screen when accessing the world map at times
[*] Crashes when you close the game by force
[*] Combat against the Wasteland Express causes a crash[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Can’t get enough wrestling RPG action? Don’t worry; we’re keeping the slams coming with balancing updates, bug fixes, and more, so let’s take [i]WrestleQuest[/i] to the next level together! We’ll be posting like this in the future before updates, so expect to see all the slamtastic features here first!

We thank you all from the bottom of our hearts for taking this journey with us to wrestling stardom. If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on to our [url=https://discord.gg/megacat]Discord[/url] and let us know. We’d be more than happy to see you there!

Happy powerbombs, everyone!

notes.title: WrestleQuest Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Mega Cat Studios and Skybound Games announced today that [i]WrestleQuest[/i] will now be launching August 22 across all platforms.

When performing final checks on one of our launch platforms, we discovered it was possible for players to lose their save game progress when playing [i]WrestleQuest[/i] on multiple different devices. 

Because this is a game filled with hours of content and player progress is so important, we could never bodyslam our fans like that.

We are truly proud of this game and believe that we have a product that delivers on all counts. We’re blown away by the support we’ve seen from players excited for [i]WrestleQuest[/i].

Thank you all. We’ll see you in the ring August 22.

- Mega Cat Studios & Skybound Games
